description: Build a structured lab protocol (purpose, materials, procedure, critical steps, acceptance criteria and more) for a protocol title, using a preset or custom sections. Returns Markdown and HTML ready to fill in or print.

sectionItems.description: Ordered protocol sections to include. Library sections use source=library and an existing id. Custom sections use source=custom with a title.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex lab protocol template builder endpoint.

includeExecutionNotes.description: Whether to include ELN execution notes for running the protocol.

includeVersionHistory.description: Whether to include protocol version history when present in sectionItems.

name: protocol_template

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: Lab protocol template
